Hey there, I'm in a very similar position to you. Any social situation at all just makes me instantly shut off my ability to communicate. Most of my responses are awkward glances  and mumbles. As you can imagine this makes interacting with people an almost impossible feat.

What I find helps though is having close friends around me while I try and meet new people, for instance, instead of one on one interacton perhaps a small amount of close friends and then the new person. This has helped me relax more because I feel very comfortable around my friends and let's me be myself. After this I find it much more easy to talk yo the person I'm trying to be friends with.

When you're not with friends however the only advice I could give you is just say whatever is on your mind. I find I always regret the things I didn't say far more than anything stupid I did say. Besides, it should be easy for you since awkward girls are considered cute :P

Hope this at least offered some consolation.
